report_identity.report_title: Huashi Group Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025
report_identity.primary_source_url: HKEX annual report PDF reused from stock_report raw filing directory

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group is a Hubei-based PRC branding, advertising and marketing service provider.
business_overview.revenue_model: Branding, event execution and multimedia advertising revenue is recognised over the service or performance period; advertisement placement and media partner rebates are recognised on a net agent basis.
business_notes: Auditor identified revenue recognition as a key audit matter.
Recoverability of trade and other receivables was also a key audit matter because receivables were quantitatively significant.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow was positive in 2024-2025 but below accounting profit on a three-year view; 2025 trade receivables rose sharply to RMB384.3 million and capital expenditure rose to RMB56.7 million, so distributable cash profit requires a material haircut.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by listed parent versus PRC operating subsidiaries beyond foreign-currency balances.
Annual report does not identify what portion of the RMB120.277 million unrestricted cash is immediately distributable offshore.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not disclosed; RMB20.0 million maintenance capex is an analyst estimate for this owner earnback analysis.
